verdict.rationale: SigNoz describes itself as an OpenTelemetry-native platform, and its docs say applications export telemetry over OTLP using standard OpenTelemetry libraries, which SigNoz then stores and queries. Logs can also be sent directly from OpenTelemetry SDKs, and independent community comments credit its OpenTelemetry basis. Missing for 10: dedicated OTLP ingestion documentation (endpoints, gRPC/HTTP protocols, auth headers) beyond the LLM-observability page, and hands-on corroboration of direct OTLP export across traces, metrics and logs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send telemetry directly over OTLP with first-class OpenTelemetry support

citations.quote: SigNoz Cloud brings your traces, metrics, and logs into one OpenTelemetry-native platform.
Your application emits gen_ai.* spans and metrics through standard OpenTelemetry libraries, exports them over OTLP, and SigNoz stores and queries them next to the rest of your application telemetry.
or instrument directly with OpenTelemetry SDKs.
Collect logs from files, stdout, FluentBit/FluentD/Logstash, OpenTelemetry SDKs, HTTP endpoints, and cloud services.
